long: Review vehicle listings using text, structured vehicle fields and photo metadata you supply. Receive a completeness score, missing information and up to five prioritised fixes, or request a checklist for Germany, the US, the UK or a generic market. Results are in English and recognise common English and German keywords. URLs are treated as strings: the tools do not fetch or scrape listing pages or media, inspect images, verify vehicle facts, appraise vehicles or certify compliance. No AI image or video generation is provided. Recommendations are editorial guidance; verify facts and applicable requirements before publishing.
prompts: Check this supplied listing: title Ford Focus Automatic; six photos.
Give me a UK used-car listing checklist.
Check this supplied German new-car title: New car. Condition: new; market: de.

pos.prompt: Check this supplied listing: title Ford Focus Automatic; six photos.
pos.expected: Score 58/100, grade D, market generic, language en. core_data: fail — Missing structured core data: make, model, price, currency, mileage, mileage_unit, fuel_type, transmission, condition, location, first_registration, service_history. photo_count: warn — 6 photos reported. Recommended minimum 8; ideal 12–20 distinct views; no portal requirement implied.

pos.prompt: Review this supplied German listing: Zustand gut, Sitzheizung, 60.000 km.
pos.expected: Score 58/100, grade D, market generic, language de. equipment: warn — Equipment topics not detected: navigation, LED headlights, adaptive cruise control, parking sensors, camera, Apple CarPlay / Android Auto, tow bar, air conditioning, alloy wheels, sunroof. Keyword presence does not prove fitment. condition_disclosure: pass — Condition and known-issue wording check.

pos.expected: Score 55/100, grade D, market de, language de. new_car_energy: warn — General guidance: new cars need applicable Pkw-EnVKV consumption, CO2 and energy-efficiency information; supplied values are not compliance-checked.

pos.description: Give me a UK used-car listing checklist.
pos.prompt: Give me a UK used-car listing checklist.
pos.expected: Market uk, vehicle_condition used; required_fields includes inspection_due; photo_shots begins front_3_4, side, rear. Full deterministic result is in test-cases.json and is asserted locally.
